scope: Container rehearsal only: Debian 13 (debian:trixie) linux/arm64 containers running natively on the aarch64 colima VM of a macOS host (no emulation). Not Arm hardware, not an Arm VM with systemd, not the deployment baseline (ADR-0002 is Debian 13 / amd64), not hardware-gate evidence, not production activation or admission (ADR-0005).

build_container.build_user: uid 1001, umask 022, clean git clone of the commit
build_container.reproducibility: not measured for the two Nexus wheels; each source-built third-party wheel reproduced its locked sha256 (checked)

wheelhouse_record.purpose_note: lab-software-verification target: VM software-integration evidence at most; never hardware-gate evidence, a deployment-baseline install or a production admission (ADR-0005)

build_container.fabric_wheel: built from the pinned commit and equal to the sha256 both locks pin (the build refuses otherwise)

bundle.slots: all empty (no Edge package, .deb, model or Knowledge carried)

offline_container.network: --network none (lo and sit0 only; outbound TCP connect failed: Network is unreachable)
offline_container.image: debian:trixie linux/arm64 + python3 python3-venv only (prepared online beforehand, committed to a temporary image and removed afterwards; no compiler, no git, no Nexus files)
offline_container.verifier: tools/offline_bundle.py from a copy of the reviewed checkout at the covered commit (mounted read-only, copied)
offline_container.tampered_copy: refused (one bit flipped near the end; gzip data check failed in the streamed reader); destination not created

report.purpose_note: lab-software-verification target: VM software-integration evidence at most; never hardware-gate evidence, a deployment-baseline install or a production admission (ADR-0005)

offline_container.imports_checked: azazel_nexus, azazel_nexus_runtime, _bootstrap_deadline (cpython-313-aarch64-linux-gnu.so), yaml (with the libyaml CSafeLoader), dbus_next, pydantic_core 2.46.5, azazel_fabric.provisioning_contracts

installer.command: /bin/sh <tree>/source/packaging/install.sh --without-service-manager, run by install --run-installer as root with PYTHON=<root-owned venv>
